Package robbery.backpacks

Class BackpackManager

java.lang.Object
robbery.backpacks.BackpackManager
public class BackpackManager extends Object
Manages all predefined backpacks in the Robbery plugin.

Provides methods to retrieve backpack instances by name, ID, or serialized data, and defines all available backpack tiers as static constants.

  • Method Details

    • toBackpack

      public static Backpacks toBackpack(String b, String material, String items, String color)
      Converts serialized backpack data into a Backpacks object.
      Parameters:
      b - the backpack name and slots in the format "name_slots_extra"
      material - the material name for the backpack chestplate
      items - serialized items as underscore-separated names
      color - the color code string
      Returns:
      a new Backpacks instance, or BACK1 if invalid

    • getBackpackName

      public static Backpacks getBackpackName(String n, int extraslots)
      Retrieves a predefined backpack by its internal ID and adds extra slots.
      Parameters:
      n - the backpack ID string (e.g., "back1")
      extraslots - number of extra slots to add
      Returns:
      a new Backpacks instance with the specified extra slots, or null if invalid ID

    • getBackpackNameR

      public static String getBackpackNameR(String n)
      Retrieves the internal ID of a backpack by its display name.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the internal ID (e.g., "back1") or null if not found
